assert src.is_dir()
def git(*args,text=True,timeout=30):
 return subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'--no-pager',*args],capture_output=True,text=text,timeout=timeout,env={**os.environ,'GIT_PAGER':'cat','PAGER':'cat','GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT':'0'})

 noteworthy=[(name,line) for name,line in methods if re.search(r'(region|session|join|invite|scrap|member|discover|human|group|filter|search|schedule|accoun|api_|worker|run_)',name,re.I)]

 }))

print('INITIAL_DB_FILES',dbs)
for name in dbs:
 size_result=git('cat-file','-s','1862998:'+name)
 size=int(size_result.stdout.strip()) if size_result.returncode==0 else -1
 print('HISTORIC_DB',name,'bytes',size)
 if size<1 or size>12000000:continue
 blob=git('show','1862998:'+name,text=False,timeout=40)
 if blob.returncode!=0:print('DB_BLOB_UNAVAILABLE');continue
 try:

 except Exception as exc:
